appraisal_events.evidence: « M. de Norpois leur aurait dit [...] que vous étiez un flatteur à moitié hystérique » ; la parole a couru « jusque chez la princesse de Guermantes » et va « divertir à nos dépens le festin des dieux ».
appraisal_events.explanation: Norpois's contemptuous label for the narrator is reported to have circulated up to the princesse de Guermantes, a world in which the narrator believed himself unknown; the long meditation that follows endorses the sting by generalizing it into the image of an unflattering X-ray of oneself held by others.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Peut-être contente d'avoir l'air d'être très occupée par quelqu'un dans ce salon où elle ne connaissait presque personne » ; « je ne parvenais pas à identifier Mme Swann à la Dame en rose de mon enfance ».
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrating voice frames Odette twice over as diminished: socially marginal in the Villeparisis salon and needing to look busy, and stripped of the aura she once had for him, her protested probity (« je suis très honnête homme ») lightly ironized by the indiscretion she is committing.

status_effects.explanation: He is locally lowered by being fixed under a ridiculing formula, softened only by the assurance that no one took it seriously given its malicious source.
His standing in the highest social space he does not yet enter is damaged in advance: he exists there only as a joke at a dinner of the princesse de Guermantes.

She is placed as an outsider in this salon, knowing almost no one and glad to seem occupied with a single interlocutor, while the closing paragraph withdraws the prestige she once held for the narrator.

ambiguities: The insult is doubly mediated: Odette reports it in the conditional (« M. de Norpois leur aurait dit »), and the narrator's own meditation entertains that such a remark may have been distorted in transit or « jamais prononcée », so Norpois's authorship of the blame is asserted socially rather than established.

The meditation leaves it open whether the caricature is a mere « décalque raté » (which would neutralize the wound) or a « photographie par les rayons X » whose truth is « peu flatteur certes, mais profond » (which would deepen it); this materially affects how severe the narrator's local diminishment should be read.
